params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { tabs?: [{ id, label }], widgets: [{ key, tab?, label, kind?: 'stat'|'chart', empty? }], sections?: [{ heading?, tab?, widgets: string[] }], filters?: [{ key, type, label, options? }], empty? }. Breaking: this replaces the earlier { tiles } shape.

params.name: Load
params.doc: Loads one widget by its key (config.widgets[].key), independently of the others, and returns what the widget draws: for a stat an object with value (and delta, trend...), for a chart the chart properties. Throwing shows that card's error state with Retry; the other widgets are unaffected.

notes: New component: App framework step 6 follow-up (issue #436, deferred from #352); reshaped to tabs + widgets + filters in #489 (a breaking change to Config: tiles became widgets). Load(key) is a callback property, set from script: the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the Load parameter once per widget key (issue #366). The current filter selections are not passed to it yet.
